title: psychotria belamboi
intro: Psychotria belamboi, commonly known as Madagascar king, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria belamboi include its ability to exert sedative and anxiolytic effects, as well as its potential to treat various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
